C1.title: the /v1/chat/completions parameter layer on llama-server b11755
C1.surface: SKILL.md new section '## Round-31 chat-completions parameter outcomes': one row per OpenAI-compatible request parameter or chat payload shape, stating what the adapter does with it (reject with an exact error envelope, map it onto a generation setting, or accept it with no observable effect), each row backed by a new S### row that quotes the pinned server-common.cpp line at 704366d; plus registry/chat-param-outcomes-r31.json. The lane has never held the chat-adapter surface: at base no lane file names server-common.cpp's chat parser and round-28's table covers only native POST /completion fields.
C1.before_command: the same counter at base 07794a4d: registry and SKILL table absent, so it exits 2 (no table) — the surface did not exist
C1.base_receipt: .ufo/waves/round-31/before/pilot-c1.json (mechanics pilot on a scratch clone: registered 3 counted 3 target 12 met False; it proves the counter distinguishes rows, not the claim)
C1.kill_rule: The counter bytes and the predicate are frozen at this commit. A miss at the landed tip is an honest stop; the predicate is not amended after any seat scores. A rule changed after any seat has scored is not this claim's rule.
C1.claimed_work: Open the chat adapter in the pinned source, measure each candidate parameter live on the lane fixture (base request then one parameter, reading /slots for the stored generation settings and the response body for the response contract), draft one SKILL row and one S### source row per counted parameter, and let the frozen counter re-derive every cell and every live outcome.
known_limits: One request per parameter on one build, model and default argv (n_slots 4); a row is one observed point, not the parameter's whole response function.
The slot-parameter reading proves what the server stored for the task, not that the sampler used it.

Ignored rows are bounded to parameters the OpenAI API documents and the pinned schema does not declare, and are measured as zero slot delta plus an unchanged normalized response; a parameter whose effect is invisible to both (e.g. logit_bias) cannot be claimed ignored and must not be a row.
Response checks cover four contract facts only (n_choices, has_logprobs, sse, sse_usage).
C1.controls_required: one 12-seat pre-data control call, committed before any data row: CtlTypeGuess and CtlSchemaProjection (the two KQ38 shortcut policies) plus CtlNoLive, CtlWrongCell, CtlTamper, and the C2 arms CtlDoNothing, CtlAllRows, CtlWrongObserved, CtlNoId, CtlEditInPlace, CtlBaseTree and RefRepair. Every arm but RefRepair must fail its counter.

C2.title: revision-keyed evidence on every SCORECARD claim row
C2.surface: every data row of every `| Claim |` table in SCORECARD.md (28 rows over 18 tables, rounds 10-30): each must name a commit that exists and is an ancestor of the measured tip (P1), name at least one evidence path that exists in the final tree (P2), and name any counter script it cites (P3), with full digests checked when pinned; failures are recorded one row each in an appended '## Round 31 — claim-row evidence corrections' table carrying the counter's exact observed value. The lane has never held this check: rounds 29 and 30 censused statement prose, not claim-table rows.
C2.predicate: Claim met iff rows >= 28 and unresolved == 0 and false_corrections == 0 and append_only is True and every non-exempt claim row is either RESOLVED or has exactly one VALID correction row.
C2.kill_rule: The counter bytes and the predicate are frozen at this commit. A miss at the landed tip is an honest stop; the predicate is not amended after any seat scores.
C2.claimed_work: Append one correction row per failing claim row, carrying the counter's exact observed string (p1:no-revision, p2:no-evidence-path, p3:counter-absent:<token>, p3:digest-mismatch:<path>=<actual>); never edit the original rows.
known_limits: P1 accepts the first hex token in the row that resolves at the tip and is an ancestor; a row that names several commits passes on any one of them.
P2 checks existence at the tip, not at the measured revision: an evidence file committed later in the same round is accepted.
P3 accepts an abbreviated digest by prefix; only a full 32/64-hex digest is compared byte for byte.
The population is the claim tables of SCORECARD.md only; other files' tables are out of scope.
C2.controls_required: the same 12-seat control call; CtlDoNothing, CtlAllRows, CtlWrongObserved, CtlNoId, CtlEditInPlace and CtlBaseTree must each fail, RefRepair meets by design.
